preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^3, inclusive.
The number of nodes in the tree is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.
The value of each node is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.
The nodes u and v are valid indices of the tree.

preconditions.expression: The graph given in the input will always be a secured tree
preconditions.description: The input tree is always secured.

preconditions.expression: Sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 10^6
preconditions.description: The sum of the number of nodes over all test cases does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the minimum security of the tree.
